title: go.mod with no module path
description: go.mod declares a module file that declares no module path. A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a module file that declares no module path.
remediation: Point the declaration or the registry configuration at the namespace the project controls, and remove the lookup path that resolves elsewhere. Specifically: fix a module file that declares no module path.
limitation: It matches a module file that declares no module path in the parsed go.mod; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
